purpose: Standing regression probe for the A2 identifier flank: writer-declared retrieval keys plus the exact-match retrieval arm. Each firing case names a memory whose body does NOT contain the queried token, so a pass cannot be explained by full-text or dense similarity. Each inert case is prose that must leave the arm unfired, which is what keeps the arm from becoming a general lexical lane.

cases.query: why does ERR_CONN_RESET_0x7f31 keep firing on startup

memory.title: Connection resets during handshake
memory.body: The socket drops mid-handshake and the retry loop gives up after three attempts.

memory.title: Choosing where fusion runs
memory.body: Fusion can execute in process or inside the database; the default is the in-process path.

memory.title: Retrieval planning lives in one module
memory.body: Plan construction, lane orchestration and fusion all sit together so a lane cannot be added without touching the plan.

memory.title: Next.js renamed the middleware entry point
memory.body: The framework now looks for the request interceptor under a different filename than it used to.

memory.title: Per-lane seed budget now scales with the request
memory.body: A lane may propose no more rows than the whole answer holds, so a wider ask pays for a wider read.

cases.query: why did std::vector<int> blow up here

memory.title: Reserve before pushing in the hot loop
memory.body: Repeated growth reallocates the buffer and invalidates every outstanding iterator.

memory.title: One pooled client per organization namespace
memory.body: Each tenant gets a dedicated pooled handle; sharing one across tenants routes queries into the wrong namespace.

cases.query: the log said "connection reset by peer" again

memory.title: Upstream closes idle sockets at sixty seconds
memory.body: The load balancer drops an idle connection well before the client's own timeout fires.

memory.title: Capture can block until the row is retrievable
memory.body: By default a capture returns as soon as the verbatim record is durable and finishes projecting in the background.

cases.query: does search.py still gate on SIBYL_FUSION_BACKEND

memory.title: The backend choice is read from the environment per query
memory.body: Nothing caches the selection, so flipping it takes effect on the next request without a restart.

memory.title: Retry budget exhausted on the second hop
memory.body: The inner call gives up first, so the outer error is a symptom rather than the cause.

cases.query: what did we decide about connection pooling
e.g. the retrieval plan we shipped
the facade pattern we accede to
why does Redis expire the TTL early
cases.note: A bare all-caps acronym deliberately does not fire: English writes acronyms identically, so admitting them would fire the arm on ordinary emphasis. A caller who needs one matched quotes it.
